stories.title: How Smart Lights Actually Work
stories.description: A visual explanation of how smart lighting works inside a home and what changes when you use it.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide interior view of a modern home during early evening, multiple rooms softly illuminated, gradual light intensity shift across rooms, slow cinematic camera drift, subtle shadow movement on walls
scenes.visual_reference: A home interior with multiple rooms softly lit during the evening.
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, futuristic sci-fi, people, hands
scenes.narration: Lighting quietly shapes how a home feels throughout the day and night.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close view of a traditional wall light switch mounted on a wall, room light softly brightening and dimming on its own, stable framing, gentle ambient shadow changes
scenes.visual_reference: A traditional wall light switch controlling a room light.
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, branded switch, hands, fingers
scenes.narration: In most homes, lights respond only when a wall switch is used.

scenes.visual_prompt: Smart light bulb installed in a ceiling fixture, brightness gradually increasing then softening, smooth light diffusion, realistic home interior, slight camera parallax
scenes.visual_reference: A smart light bulb installed in a ceiling fixture with adjustable brightness.
scenes.narration: Smart lights adjust brightness and color without changing the fixture itself.

scenes.visual_prompt: Home interior with lights visible across rooms, soft glowing signal waves flowing slowly through the air toward fixtures, subtle pulsing motion, calm realistic environment
scenes.visual_reference: Wireless signals connecting lights inside a home.
scenes.narration: Commands are sent wirelessly, allowing lights to respond without physical switches.

scenes.visual_prompt: Home router resting on a shelf, indicator lights blinking in slow repeating rhythm, soft ambient room lighting, static camera with subtle depth-of-field breathing
scenes.visual_reference: A home router connecting smart devices within the house.
scenes.narration: Most smart lights communicate through the home network to stay connected.

scenes.visual_prompt: Living room lighting smoothly transitioning from cool daylight tones to warm evening tones, shadows slowly stretching, calm atmosphere, gentle camera drift
scenes.visual_reference: Living room lights adjusting automatically as the time of day changes.
scenes.narration: Over time, smart lighting becomes part of a daily home routine.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide modern home interior at night, balanced smart lighting across rooms, steady ambient glow, slow cinematic camera drift, calm settled atmosphere
scenes.visual_reference: A calm home interior with balanced smart lighting throughout the space.
scenes.narration: Smart lighting quietly adapts to support comfort without constant attention.
